mapper.select: SELECT dev_id FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}

WITH months AS (SELECT to_char(x,'YYYY-MM') AS month,x::date AS first_day, (x + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AS last_day FROM generate_series((#{from}||'-01')::date,(#{through}||'-01')::date,interval '1 month') x) SELECT d.dev_id,m.month,d.dev_nm,coalesce(v.ptnr_nm,'자사') AS affiliation, coalesce(s.emp_se_cd,d.emp_se_cd) AS emp_se_cd,coalesce(s.duty_se_cd,d.duty_se_cd) AS duty_se_cd, coalesce(s.bsn_part_id,d.bsn_part_id) AS bsn_part_id,d.vndr_ptnr_id AS vendor_id, d.main_job_cd AS job,d.grd_cd AS grade,d.pstn_cd AS position, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=d.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt <= m.last_day AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt >= m.first_day)) AS on_leave, s.slry_amt AS salary,s.alwnc_amt AS allowance,s.sins_cmpny_amt AS insurance, s.rtrpay_acml_amt AS retirement,s.sins_emp_amt AS employee_insurance, s.whtax_amt AS withholding,s.real_pay_amt AS real_pay FROM mst.dev d CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr v ON v.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst s ON s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=m.month WHERE (d.hire_dt IS NULL OR d.hire_dt <= m.last_day) AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt >= m.first_day) AND (d.use_yn='Y' OR s.dev_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM cst.cst_aloc c WHERE c.dev_id=d.dev_id AND c.cst_ym=m.month)) ORDER BY d.dev_id,m.month

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm AS project,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, a.job_cd AS job,a.bgn_dt AS start,a.end_dt AS end FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.bgn_dt <= (#{through}||'-01')::date + interval '1 month - 1 day' AND a.end_dt >= (#{from}||'-01')::date ORDER BY a.asgn_id
